career_ladder.note: Clerks in Haryana form the foundational ministerial cadre across Haryana Civil Secretariat, Financial Commissioner Revenue, District Commissioners' offices, and statutory boards. Promotion is governed by the Haryana Ministerial Services Rules.

steps.source_label: HSSC Advt No. 03/2023 (Group 57 10+2 Level Posts) & Haryana Ministerial Service Rules

steps.years: approx. 6-10 yrs (subject to state typing qualification & seniority)
steps.source_label: Haryana Government Subordinate Services Promotion Rules
Haryana Civil Secretariat Ministerial Promotion Cadre Rules

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment for Clerks in Haryana is conducted through HSSC Group C Common Eligibility Test as part of Group 57 (Higher Secondary 10+2 Level Posts), followed by state computer typing clearance.

stages.stage_name: Common Eligibility Test (CET Group C Screening)
stages.source_label: HSSC CET Group C Notification & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Screening Examination (General Studies, Reasoning, Quantitative Ability, Languages & Haryana GK)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.95 deducted if fifth bubble left blank
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying cutoff for shortlisting to Group 57 Mains

stages.stage_name: HSSC Group 57 Mains Written Examination (10+2 Level Posts)
stages.source_label: HSSC Group 57 Mains Examination Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Core Subject Knowledge & General Aptitude (70% weightage: General Awareness, Reasoning, Maths, Science, English, Hindi, and Computer Operations)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; mandatory fifth bubble

papers.paper_name: Haryana History, Civics, Geography, Environment, Literature & Culture (20% weightage) and Computer Literacy (10% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; mandatory fifth bubble

stages.stage_name: State Computer Typing Test (SETH / HARTRON / Departmental)

papers.paper_name: Typing Speed Test (30 words per minute in English or Hindi on Computer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 30 wpm typing speed with prescribed accuracy

financial_package.note: Clerks in Haryana are placed in Functional Pay Level 2 (FPL-2) under Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, with entry basic pay of ₹19,900.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 (FPL-2 scale ₹19,900 – ₹63,200)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry Level 2 basic pay of ₹19,900 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹11,542), House Rent Allowance (8% to 24%), and fixed medical allowance (₹1,000), minus standard employee NPS and insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) at prevailing state rates (58% effective 1 Jul 2025)
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by City Grade (X/Y/Z: 24%/16%/8%)
Fixed Medical Allowance (FMA) / Cashless Medical Scheme
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with employer matching contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Haryana Civil Services Rules

competition_benchmarks.note: Clerical recruitment in Haryana has historically generated some of the largest applicant counts in state public sector employment.

years.source_label: HSSC Corrigendum to Advt. No. 04/2024 (parent dated 2024-06-28) — Group 57, Cat. 380, Ministerial Clerk: originally 5,208, revised to 5,930 via corrigendum dated 2024-08-14. Owner-verified against screenshot, 2026-09-19.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 8 (calculated: shortlisted CET candidates ÷ Group 57 clerk vacancies)
years.source_label: HSSC Advt 03/2023 Group 57 (10+2 Level): 3,800+ ministerial clerk vacancies across Haryana government departments.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 308 (calculated: registered applicants ÷ notified vacancies)
years.source_label: HSSC Advt 05/2019 (Clerk recruitment): 4,858 vacancies; over 15 lakh applicants; 10.4 lakh appeared in written examination on 21-23 September 2019.
